presets.name: 速度线冲击帧
presets.description: 漫剪核心特效：放射状速度线+画面震动+冲击闪白。模拟一拳超人/鬼灭之刃高燃打击帧
presets.jsx_template: (function(){var _r={};try{var c=app.project.activeItem;if(!c||!(c instanceof CompItem)){_r={status:'error',message:'No active comp'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var presets.name: 漫画分格切换
